newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Strike continues at Rustenburg Platinum.
newsitem.headline: Strike continues at Rustenburg Platinum.

text.p: South Africa's Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd, the world's biggest producer, said that an illegal strike by 4,600 workers at the Amandelbult section of Rustenburg Platinum Holdings Ltd continued on Wednesday.
A company spokesman said the morning shift had not reported for work.
"The strike is still on. It hasn't spread," Amplats spokesman Johan Adler told Reuters.
He said that 15 to 20 percent of production had been affected at Rustenburg since Monday night when the wildcat strike began.
The problem started when employees at two Amandelbult workers hostels took illegal industrial action over the Friday sacking of an employee.
The workers did not turn up for Monday's night shift and a fight broke out at one of the hostels between strikers and employees who wanted to work. One worker was injured.
